segments.text:
V. 2.
Every one that beareth fruit, be purifieth—by obeying the truth, Pet. i. 22. and by inward or outward Sufferings, Heb. xii. 10, 11. So Purity and Fruitfulneſs help each other. That it may bear more fruit—For this is one of the nobleſt Rewards GOD can beſtow on former Acts of Obedience, to make us yet more holy, and ſit for farther and more eminent Service.
